# Industrial Packaging

> > Industrial Packaging supplies flexible packaging materials, machinery, and contract packaging services with technical expertise since 1959.

Industrial Packaging is a Massachusetts-based provider of packaging solutions for food, CPG, and industrial markets. The company offers a comprehensive range of flexible packaging materials (shrink film, stretch wrap, specialty films), packaging machinery and equipment, spare parts, contract packaging services, and technical support across the Northeastern United States.

## Key Topics

- Flexible Packaging
- Contract Packaging
- Shrink Film
- Stretch Wrap
- Packaging Machinery
- Sustainable Packaging
- SQF Certification
- Heat Seal Tubing
- Pouch Packaging
- Blister Packaging
- Technical Support
- Supply Chain Services
- Equipment Maintenance
- Food Packaging
- Packaging Materials

## Products & Materials

- [Source Packaging Materials, Packaging Machinery and Parts](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/products): Main product catalog for flexible packaging materials, machinery, and parts.
- [Flexible Packaging Materials From Industrial Packaging](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/products/flexible-packaging-materials): Flexible packaging materials including shrink film and stretch wrap for multiple markets.
- [Stretch Wrap For Palletizing | Packaging Supplies | Packaging Products](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/products/stretch-wrap): Stretch wrap products for palletizing, transit, and storage protection.
- [Sustainable Packaging | Green Packaging | Eco Friendly Packaging](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/packaging-materials/sustainable-materials): Eco-friendly and recyclable packaging materials and sustainable solutions.
- [Reliable Packaging Films For Foods](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/food-packaging-contact): High-quality packaging films for food industry including heat shrink and barrier films.

## Machinery & Equipment

- [Packaging Machinery | Packaging Equipment](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/products/machinery): Packaging machinery including heat sealers, shrink equipment, baggers, and strappers.
- [Packaging Parts | Industrial Packaging](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/products/parts): Spare and replacement parts for packaging machinery throughout the United States.

## Services

- [Industrial Packaging Services](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/services): Contract packaging, technical support, and preventative maintenance services.
- [Contract Packaging & Supply Chain Services from Industrial Packaging](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/services/contract-packaging): Contract packaging for primary/secondary packaging, kitting, and display builds.
- [Packaging Equipment Technical Service | Industrial Packaging Services](https://www.industrialpackaging.com/services/technical-service): Technical support and maintenance for packaging machinery in Northeastern United States.
